name: IC — USB — Texas
description: Cluster of 5 surface-mount USB ICs using Texas footprints such as Texas_DRT-3, Texas_R-PUSON-N14, Texas_DPY0002A_0.6x1mm_P0.65mm, and Texas_S-PWSON-N10.
selection_hints: Prefer tier A rated parts like TPD2EUSB30, TPD2EUSB30A, or TPD6E05U06RVZ.
Match required SMD land patterns against footprints such as Texas_DRT-3 or Texas_S-PWSON-N10.
Choose TPD1E05U06DPY or TPD4S014 when tier B quality selection is acceptable.
avoid_when: The design requires non-SMD or through-hole mounting.
Land patterns other than the listed Texas footprints are required.
Components outside the KiCad Power_Protection USB IC symbols are needed.
